quotes.text: The 2024 port moved the test exclusion to the comm license linter YAML so ./mach commlint -l license used the upstream linter behavior. Current YAML still excludes **/test*. This is a configuration fact, not a style rule: check the current YAML and linter before adding a new exception, and do not infer that excluded tests should omit license headers.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
